metadata.summary: Predicted starburst efficiency amplification from elastic-enhanced collapse and metallicity.
metadata.explanation: The starburst-efficiency curve quantifies how elastic cosmology enhances high-redshift starburst activity. Earlier collapse and modified wave propagation increase the efficiency of star formation compared to ΛCDM. Observations of extreme star-formers at z > 4 can test this prediction.
